description: Single-VM scenario delivering an Ubuntu LTS host with the Docker baseline (docker, docker compose, zsh, curl, git, jq, vim, network utils) and the Rocket.Chat docker-compose stack on vmbr142. Bridge vmbr142, IP 192.168.142.185, VMID 1185 (convention : last 3 digits of vm_id match the IP last octet). Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is created by this scenario's 01_init_proxmox/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as blank_scenario_2_subnets, demo_lab, or misp_lab).
